description: Reads the tab as accessibility-tree text. Clickable/typable elements get refs like [e12]. Long pages are split; only page 1 (top) is shown (page=2 to continue; refs stay the same across pages). find="text" shows only matching elements with their parent context; ref="e40" shows only that element's subtree. Refs change when the page changes, so re-snapshot before acting.

agent.description: Your display name, shown to other agents. Subagents must always set it. Default "claude-d26d".

find.description: Only lines containing this text, with parent context (ignores case and spaces). If unsure of site language, use | for alternatives, e.g. "제목|subject"

interactive.description: Only actionable elements (lines with refs): inputs, buttons, links. Use first to find inputs on big pages like Gmail

multiSlot.description: true only when one agent must handle several slots together (e.g. comparing). Normally omit (one agent = one slot; use subagents for the rest)

ref.description: Only this ref element and its subtree

slot.description: Browser slot 1-30. "3", "slot 3", "browser 3" → 3. If the user gives a port like 14052, subtract 14049.

tab.description: Target tab: number (1, 2…) or ID ("t7"). Use the stable ID when agents share a slot. Required for action tools when there are multiple tabs.
